Class ControlPanelPlaybackSection

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.control.ControlPanelPlaybackSection
public class ControlPanelPlaybackSection extends Object
Temporal clock, scenario/date status header, DB/cluster telemetry badge, and playback speed card for ControlPanel.

Extracted from ControlPanel in accordance with the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) to isolate transport buttons (rewind, step, play/pause, fast-forward, seek-to-end), logarithmic/piecewise speed scaling, and database/cluster connection status rendering.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
